description: The account's vignettes and other tolls (bridge passes), newest first, one page at a time: status, vehicle, period, price in RON, serial. Filter by status or plate; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

plate.description: Only tolls for this plate number (spaces and dashes do not matter).

status.description: Only tolls in this status: ACTIVE (valid now or later), EXPIRED, and so on. An unpaid order is not a toll yet; get_order reads one.

name: list_tolls
title: List tolls
